conventions.fn: FeeBank.apply(Bank storage b, Op op, bytes args) -> (burnShares, payShares, a, b2); in.bank is the state before, out.bank after; out = {revert: <error>} when apply reverts (state unchanged).
conventions.Op: enum Op {Accrue, Breach, VestTime, Drip, Charge, Place, Retire, Claim, TopUp, Release}; opIndex = ordinal.
conventions.args: Accrue (epoch, shares, gateOpen); Breach (count, now); VestTime (nowEpoch, gateOpen); Drip (now); Charge (burn); Place (); Retire (now); Claim (); TopUp (shares); Release (shares, now).
conventions.returns: Charge (bank burned, bond burned); Breach/Retire (forfeited, mode after); VestTime/Accrue (vested, moved to maturedPending); Drip (burned, 0); Claim/TopUp/Release/Place (shares moved, 0). Breach and Retire first burn the drip owed at `now` (returned as burnShares), then forfeit; an empty forfeit does not restart the drip.
conventions.cohorts: V = 4; ring of V+1 = 5 slots {epoch, shares} at index epoch mod 5; a cohort vests when nowEpoch >= epoch + 1 + V; Charge burns cohorts youngest (highest epoch) first, then maturedPending, then the bond.
conventions.mode: 0 NORMAL, 1 BREACHED, 2 EXITED. Release requires EXITED and now >= exitBlock + releaseDelay.
conventions.tier: dripBlocks and releaseDelay are Bank fields written at seed (TEST: 120 and 480; DEMO cases: 3600, 14400).
